title: Machine learning suggests a more general theory of microlensing
summary: An algorithm highlighted microlensing configurations not explained by usual interpretations, leading to a theory unifying two degeneracies. The authors report a better fit to data from two dozen previous discoveries; they describe the theory as probably incomplete.
organization: UC Berkeley / The Ohio State University

evidence.tested: The machine-learning-derived theory was checked against the datasets of two dozen earlier microlensing discoveries and fit them better than the earlier interpretations.
evidence.unknown: The authors say the broader theory is likely still incomplete, and the multi-planet case is not yet worked out.
evidence.ai_role: Algorithm highlighted microlensing configurations not explained by the usual interpretations.
